title: Alpha lab opens a riverside archive
author: Ada West
body: Alpha Lab announced that its riverside archive opened on Monday. The archive holds climate field notes from the last decade.

title: Beta institute signs a river research pact
author: Ben Oak
body: The Beta Institute signed a river research pact with Alpha Lab. The pact funds a shared sensor network along the same river.

title: Gamma festival dates remain unchanged
author: Cara Lin
body: The Gamma festival will still begin on October 12, according to city organizers. Ticket prices remain at forty dollars.
